newsitem.title: UK: Willis to pay 41 mln stg for French stake.
newsitem.headline: Willis to pay 41 mln stg for French stake.

text.p: British insurance broker Willis Corroon Plc said on Thursday it would pay around 41 million stg in cash for its one-third stake in the largest independent French insurance broker Gras Savoye & Cie.
The group said in a statement it had conditionally agreed to purchase 31.72 percent of Gras Savoye's share capital.
The consideration will be met not only by the cash payment, but by the transfer to Gras Savoye of Willis Corroon's current operations in France, Willis Corroon France SA.

"The powerful combination of Willis Corroon's global expertise in specialist insurance and Gras Savoye's leading position in the French market will enhance the ability of each group to attract and service both multinational clients and international clients based in France," chairman John Reeve said in a statement.
